WITH data AS ( SELECT a.worker_id, activity_date, To_Char(a.activity_date,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') || ' - '|| Nvl(Trim(pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (b.last_name, b.first_name, b.middle_name, NULL)), a.activity_by) ||' - '|| a.comments notes FROM nyehms_users_activity a LEFT JOIN nyehms_users b ON (b.legacy_uid = a.activity_by AND b.end_date IS NULL) ), final_notes AS ( SELECT worker_id, LISTAGG(notes, chr(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY activity_date) notes FROM data GROUP BY worker_id ) SELECT a.worker_id, legacy_uid, pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (last_name, first_name, middle_name, NULL) user_name, last_name, first_name, email_addr, bureau_name, last_login_date, is_locked, end_date, TO_CHAR(last_conf_security_trng_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') SNC_TRNG_DT, CONF_SECURITY_TRNG_BY, CONF_SECURITY_TRNG_ATTEST_REC, telecommute, TO_CHAR(telecommute_trng_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') TELE_TRNG_DT, TELECOMMUTE_TRNG_BY, TELECOMMUTE_TRNG_ATTEST_REC, user_type, vpn, TO_CHAR(vpn_approve_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') vpn_approve_date, pc_access_at_location, remote_terminal_access, CASE WHEN is_locked = 'Y' and user_type = 'APP' THEN 'User_Inactive' WHEN Add_Months(TRUNC(last_conf_security_trng_date), 12) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'C&S_Due_Now' WHEN Add_Months(TRUNC(last_conf_security_trng_date), 12) - 30 < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'C&S_Due_In_30Days' WHEN Add_Months(TRUNC(last_conf_security_trng_date), 12) - 60 < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'C&S_Due_In_60Days' WHEN Add_Months(TRUNC(last_conf_security_trng_date), 12) - 90 < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'C&S_Due_In_90Days' ELSE 'Active' END snc_due_in_days, b.notes, a.admin_county_region_cd, c.admin_county_region_desc county_region FROM nyehms_users a LEFT JOIN final_notes b ON (b.worker_id = a.worker_id) LEFT JOIN coded_admin_county_region c ON (c.admin_county_region_cd = a.admin_county_region_cd) WHERE a.END_DATE is null AND (Trunc(last_conf_security_trng_date) BETWEEN To_Date(#{p_from_date}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') AND To_Date(#{p_to_date}, 'MM/DD/YYYY')
or
Add_Months(TRUNC(last_conf_security_trng_date), 12) - sysdate < 90 )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN snc_due_in_days = 'User_Inactive' THEN '5' WHEN snc_due_in_days = 'C&S_Due_In_30Days' THEN '2' WHEN snc_due_in_days = 'C&S_Due_In_60Days' THEN '3' WHEN snc_due_in_days = 'C&S_Due_In_90Days' THEN '4' WHEN snc_due_in_days = 'C&S_Due_Now' THEN '1' END, last_conf_security_trng_date desc
